description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for staff who work away from the office. On an authorised exercise at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier, you first walk two days on the road, a train, a café, a hotel and a morning at home, making the everyday choices and seeing where each one led. Then you sort the safe public networks and sign-in pages from the look-alikes. Only that part is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down. No real network is joined and no real password is ever typed.
